thread:
emma_ops: FYI vendor updated wave schedule for PO 901222. Main ship moves from 2026-06-02 -> 2026-06-24. They offered a split-air option for 25 H100s at +3% expedite fee.
leo_procure: ok can you paste the vendor note?
emma_ops: Vendor note: "We can partial-air 25 H100s (ETA 2026-06-12) if buyer accepts 3% expedite + air uplift. Remaining H100s sea on 2026-06-24. A800s unaffected."
sanjay_infra: we're seeing sustained pressure on us-east inference pools. Losing 25 H100s through that window will push some customers to degraded throughput. If we can get at least 20 routed to us-east it's worth the cost.
leo_procure: initial counter: 2% expedite + vendor provides 4-unit RMA reserve (credit if unused) and vendor covers air-to-hub freight; we cover final-mile returns and EU brokerage if returns originate there.
emma_ops: 2% + 4-unit reserve sounds reasonable if we get written SLA on thermal acceptance and a single consolidated AWB for returns.
joey_logistics: inbound note: if vendor splits air/sea we need a separate intake plan for the express tranche. Please confirm AWB consolidation back to our SFO returns hub or else depot sorting load increases 3x. Also we need serial list 48h before flight.
Vendor: We can provide serial manifest 48h prior. Air uplift estimate per unit $390. We will do single AWB to buyer hub if buyer agrees to final-mile for EU returns.
leo_procure: can we negotiate air uplift lower? $390 seems high vs our forwarder rates. I'll ask for $300. Also push for RMA reserve converted to invoice credit if unused.
sanjay_infra: request: include a thermal failure threshold. If arrival failure rate >2% we want vendor to cover return freight and unit credit. Otherwise we absorb DOA processing.
leo_procure: flagged. counter-offer draft to vendor: 2% expedite + $300/unit air uplift, 4-unit RMA buffer credited if unused, vendor pays hub freight, buyer covers final-mile EU returns up to $1,000/unit, vendor covers return freight for thermal failure >2%. Need vendor written acceptance.
Vendor: Acknowledged, will review.
rma_bot: Automated: opened RMA prep RMA-20260612-04 for possible express tranche returns; assigned to joey_logistics.
joey_logistics: Acknowledged. I'll prep intake SOP and AWB template. Snippet below:
````
Express tranche intake checklist:
- 48h preflight serial manifest (CSV)
- Single consolidated inbound AWB to SFO-HUB for US returns
- EU returns: photo evidence, serial match; buyer covers final-mile customs clearance fee cap $1,000/unit
- RMA buffer: 4 units held as credit; vendor to issue credit memo if not used within 30 days
- Thermal failure SLA: vendor covers return freight & unit credit if >2% DOA on arrival
````
emma_ops: quick risk note: if we accept split-air, confirm insurance extension for in-transit damage under air policy. Also ensure our inventory tags are updated to reserve the 4-unit buffer so we don't double-count capacity.
sanjay_infra: ops will mark reserved serials as "RMA-buffer" on receipt. Also request a rollback clause: if actual usable arrival < 95% for express tranche, we can request immediate replacement shipments for missing capacity.
leo_procure: pushing vendor for written amendment with those clauses. I'll ask for final acceptance by COB. If vendor refuses the 2%/4-unit terms, fallback = accept full sea shipment and perform short-term loan from APAC pool (we discussed borrowing 15 A800s earlier).
joey_logistics: note to infra: if cross-pool loan happens, we need netsec tunnel and manifest exchange; allow 24h lead to reimage and shipment.
rma_bot: Automated: vendor responded "under review" to PO amendment. I'll post again when vendor confirms.
emma_ops: thanks. approving provisional: proceed with negotiation for 2% + $300 uplift + 4-unit RMA credit; infra and logistics aligned on intake SOP. If we get written terms by COB, we greenlight partial-air. :thumbsup:
